entry.notRun: no desktop: the card answer is built with normalizeHumanResponse and recorded through recordHumanDecision as the desktop delivers it
entry.runs: human-gate/gate.mjs (humanGateDecision, recordHumanDecision, unattended approval port), requests.mjs (humanRequestFields, normalizeHumanResponse), store.mjs (createHumanGateStore, agentPermissions, setAgentPermission), session-grants.mjs (createSessionGrants on a movable clock), outbound-policy.mjs, config updateSection

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay.entry: mixdog-tools policy (gate.rs, grants.rs, card.rs): replay each log step in order (decide / choose / answer / advance / reset / grant / setMode / setAgentPermission / config) on a store and a session-grant registry with the recorded clock (start 1_000_000 ms) and compare every step's output and the grants/audit views
